newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-MIM says to cut Hilton mine output.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-MIM says to cut Hilton mine output.

text.p: MIM Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it will reduce ore mined from its Hilton lead and zinc mine in Queensland to 900,000 tonnes a year from 1.3 million.
The reduction will result in slightly lower production of zinc concentrate, while lead bullion output is expected to stay the same, MIM said.
The change is aimed at improving the mine's economics in view of the present outlook for metals prices and foreign exchange currency rates, MIM said in a statement.
"To do this, the mine will be targeting ore that will give higher mineral recovery from lower ore producion, but without limiting any future mining options," the company said.
Ore from the Hilton mine is processed at the nearby Mount Isa operations of MIM.
